svg.title: Element Lens
svg.desc: CHROME + EDGE EXTENSION · MANIFEST V3. Point at any element on a web page and hand it to an AI agent as ready-made context: markup, styles and where it lives on the page. Flow: pick an element, capture its context, paste it to an agent.
